note: Notification clocks. The gate accepts deadline_hours only when it matches a rule here for a cited source; the coordinator compares exercise timing against each rule. hours=null means the text sets no fixed period.

rules.duty: inform TDRA, interconnecting operators and customers of an unplanned interruption
rules.quote: the Licensee shall inform the TDRA, any interconnecting Other Licensed Operators and relevant Customers as soon as possible

rules.duty: notify emergency services of an outage affecting emergency calls (the clause names TDRA, operators and customers only)
rules.quote: the Licensee shall inform the TDRA, any interconnecting Other Licensed Operators and relevant Customers as soon as possible

rules.duty: notify the Bureau of a personal data breach
rules.quote: within the period and in accordance with the measures and requirements set by the Executive Regulations of this Decree by Law

rules.duty: notify the Commission, ISED and emergency management organisations of a major outage
rules.quote: TSPs must notify the Commission, ISED, and FPT EMOs within two hours

rules.duty: notify PSAPs of a major 9-1-1 outage
rules.quote: 9-1-1 network providers and originating network providers must notify (i) PSAPs within 30 minutes

rules.duty: wireless provider notifies the FCC of a qualifying outage
rules.quote: All wireless service providers shall submit electronically a Notification to the Commission within 120 minutes of discovering

rules.duty: notify a potentially affected 911 special facility
rules.quote: shall provide a 911 outage notification to a potentially affected 911 special facility as soon as possible, but no later than within 30 minutes of discovering

rules.duty: early warning of a significant incident to the CSIRT or competent authority
rules.quote: without undue delay and in any event within 24 hours of becoming aware of the significant incident, an early warning

rules.duty: notify the supervisory authority of a personal data breach
rules.quote: not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, notify the personal data breach to the supervisory authority
